entries.name: def run(context, stack)
entries.signature: def run(context, stack): ...   # the only entry point; context = {instruction, initial_observation, vocabulary, capabilities}
entries.purpose: One-shot task orchestration program, INTERPRETED (never exec'd). It may branch on structured results and loop within fixed bounds; it never controls the robot directly.

supported.statements: name = value; if/elif/else; for x in range(<int literal 0..8>) or for x in <held list of <= 16 items>; break; continue; return; pass
supported.expressions: str/int/float/bool/None literals, lists, tuples, dicts with string-literal keys, indexing value[key], and/or/not, comparisons (== != < <= > >= in, not in, is), x if c else y, + on two strings / two lists / two integers (use str(x) for others; failure_reason may be None)
supported.calls: stack.<method>(...) for the methods below, len(x), str(x); nothing else (no attribute reads such as d.get or list.append)

preconditions: exactly one top-level `def run(context, stack):`; no imports, helpers, classes, while, try, with, raise, comprehensions, lambdas, augmented assignment
no names starting with _; `stack` only as stack.<method>(...); results are read by indexing (every result has a fixed set of keys)
entries.completion: returning from run() ends orchestration; stack.finish(status, reason) records the program's own declared stop (a claim, not success)

entries.name: stack.subgoal / stack.check / stack.plan
entries.signature: stack.subgoal(relation, object=None, reference=None, part=None, side=None, object_side=None, instance=None) -> {id, supported, why, ...}; stack.check(sg) -> {supported, why, implemented}; stack.plan([sg, ...]) -> {status, references | unsupported}
entries.purpose: Declare subgoals from vocabulary phrases (no free-text prompts); capability check = the frozen la_dispatch; plan() freezes the ordered subgoal list ONCE and resolves the VB task-start identity reference of every object subgoal before any object moves.
entries.supported: relations and side words: see context['capabilities']; phrases: context['vocabulary']

arguments.side: a side word (left/right/front/back/top/bottom/middle) implemented for the relation, or None

preconditions: subgoal() only before plan()
plan() exactly once, with 1-8 distinct subgoals, all supported; any unsupported subgoal refuses the whole plan (nothing moves)
entries.completion: plan status 'ok' with references[{id, handle, status: frozen|unresolved|none}]; an 'unresolved' reference makes that subgoal's execute end binding_failed (identity_unknown) without motion
failure_states: unsupported (why: relation | side | object_side | vocabulary | reference_kind | part_not_allowed)
entries.contract: Interface contract stricter than la_dispatch: an object relation's reference must be a support or object phrase (never an articulated part such as a microwave: in_hinged is not implemented); a part argument only for in_sliding.
entries.handoff: the frozen reference is what the executor's pre-grasp and post-grasp identity gates compare against
entries.example:
a = stack.subgoal('on', object='white mug', reference='plate', side='left')
b = stack.subgoal('on', object='yellow and white mug', reference='plate', side='right')
p = stack.plan([a, b])

entries.name: stack.execute(sg) / stack.recover(result, action)
entries.purpose: Run the complete frozen subgoal executor for a planned subgoal and return structured evidence.

result_fields: status: control_completed | binding_failed | execution_failed | verification_failed | unsupported | unknown | refused
verification_status: shadow_recorded_only | stack_verifier_claim_positive | stack_verifier_claim_negative | gate_refused | not_verified

preconditions: sg in the plan; each subgoal executes once; a second attempt only via recover(result, 'retry_subgoal') when allowed_recovery_actions lists it
entries.completion: control_completed is control completion, never task success (the benchmark evaluator decides success)
failure_states: refused: no_plan / subgoal_not_in_plan / already_control_completed / already_executed / budget_*
entries.handoff: the wrapper reproduces the baseline driver: production home + 3 observations before every subgoal after the first; previously returned placements are obstacles (others_xy)
entries.recovery: reobserve, go_home always; retry_subgoal once per subgoal (3 per episode) only when the evidence shows the object is not retained (object_possibly_retained == False) and the status is a failure. Never after control_completed.

entries.name: stack.observe / stack.robot_state / stack.locate / stack.reference
entries.signature: stack.observe() -> {obs_id, image_shape, tcp_position, tcp_quat_wxyz, gripper_opening}; stack.locate(phrase, object_side=None) -> {found, centre, binding_status}; stack.reference(sg) -> {handle, status}
entries.purpose: Fresh public observation summaries and perception-only text binding (localize_target) for branching, e.g. whether an object is still visible or where it is now.
entries.supported: locate: vocabulary phrases only; result is text binding, NOT an identity confirmation (identity gates live inside execute)
preconditions: budgets: reobserve 20, locate 10

entries.name: stack.budget / stack.log / stack.finish
entries.signature: stack.budget() -> {used, limits}; stack.log(message, data=None); stack.finish(status, reason=None)
entries.purpose: Inspect remaining budgets, leave notes in the episode log, declare the program's stop reason (a claim, not success).
entries.example: stack.finish('stopped', 'subgoal 1 binding failed after one retry')

entries.name: stack.execute(<on subgoal>)
entries.signature: stack.subgoal('on', object=<object phrase>, reference=<support/object phrase>, side=<side word|None>, object_side=<side word|None>) -> subgoal; stack.execute(subgoal) -> result
entries.purpose: Pick the object and place it ON a support (support centre; top face with side 'top'; plate instance chosen by side).

arguments.object: phrase from vocabulary.objects (prompts come from the frozen adapter lexicon)
arguments.reference: phrase from vocabulary.supports (or a second object phrase as the reference)
arguments.side: side word selecting the reference instance / region (must be implemented for this relation)
arguments.object_side: side word selecting the object instance (left/right/front/back/top/bottom/middle)

preconditions: the subgoal is in the frozen plan (stack.plan) - task-start identity references were taken there
stack.check(subgoal).supported is True (la_dispatch)
the hand is empty (the wrapper homes before every subgoal after the first)
entries.completion: status == 'control_completed' means PLACE_RESULT released (object released at the target and the hand retreated). It is NOT verified task success: verification_status is 'shadow_recorded_only'.
failure_states: binding_failed (BINDING_STOP: target not bound unambiguously / support_not_found / region_direction_undefined; VB identity_unknown) - pre-motion
execution_failed (approach / transport / lift non-arrival, infeasible candidate, all grasp strategies failed)
verification_failed (enforced gate refused: grasp_not_verified, object_lost_after_lift, lift_refused, VB transport gate, release_blocked)
entries.handoff: Inside the executor (frozen, enforced): VB pre-grasp identity against the task-start reference; grasp contact verification; E1 lift / transport guards; VB transport gate = identity verified AND hold verified AND object rose with the gripper; MC release gate (descent reached or contact established). Placement verifiers MF/V1 run in SHADOW mode: their verdicts are reported as shadow_verdicts and never gate.
entries.recovery: reobserve, go_home always; retry_subgoal once per subgoal (3 per episode) only when the evidence shows the object is not retained (object_possibly_retained == False) and the status is a failure. Never after control_completed.

entries.name: stack.execute(<close_articulated subgoal>)
entries.signature: stack.subgoal('close_articulated', reference=<part or support phrase>, part=<part phrase|None>, side=<side word|None>) -> subgoal; stack.execute(subgoal) -> result
entries.purpose: Close an articulated part (drawer / door) by bounded push cycles.

arguments.reference: phrase from vocabulary.articulated (a part) or vocabulary.supports
arguments.side: side word selecting the part (where implemented)

preconditions: the subgoal is in the frozen plan
stack.check(subgoal).supported is True
entries.completion: status == 'control_completed' means the executor returned True: its own perception verifier claimed 'closed' (verification_status 'stack_verifier_claim_positive'). This claim controlled the executor's loop; it is not official task success.
failure_states: execution_failed (*_STOP motion_* / plan not found / cycles exhausted)
entries.handoff: Executor-internal: bounded measure -> act -> re-observe cycles with its own verdict; abort paths open the gripper and home.
entries.recovery: reobserve, go_home; retry_subgoal once only when object_possibly_retained == False (a stop in mid-motion leaves the hand state unknown: no retry).
